name: The Signature Scent Collector
bio: A dedicated home fragrance and self-care lover who relies on Bath & Body Works for an uplifting, aromatic lifestyle. From setting the mood with iconic 3-wick candles to maintaining a daily self-care routine with nourishing scented body care and hand soaps, they prioritize relaxation, seasonal fragrance updates, and indulgence.

name: The Thoughtful Gifting Expert
bio: A social connector focused on sharing joy through beautifully packaged gift sets, soothing hand soaps, and trending seasonal aromas. They rely on Bath & Body Works for effortless, crowd-pleasing presents and quick everyday luxuries that brighten friends' and family members' homes.
